scenes.title: The on-chain research workflow
scenes.sub: Turn research into a written thesis with invalidation and monitoring.
scenes.vo: Lesson six point four. The on-chain research workflow. By the end of this lesson, you'll be able to turn research into a written thesis with invalidation and monitoring.

scenes.title: The plan
scenes.vo: Here's the plan. First, the key ideas. Then, a worked example, step by step. Then, your checklist. And finally, a three-question quiz.
scenes.cap: Here's the plan. First, the key ideas. Then, a worked example, step by step. Then, your checklist. And finally, a three-question quiz.

scenes.sub: Question first → primary sources (docs, contracts, governance) → economic reality (fees vs incentives) → cross-check with independent data → thesis: what must be true, what would prove it wrong, what to monitor.
scenes.vo: Question first to primary sources (docs, contracts, governance) to economic reality (fees versus incentives) to cross-check with independent data to thesis: what must be true, what would prove it wrong, what to monitor.
scenes.cap: Question first → primary sources (docs, contracts, governance) → economic reality (fees vs incentives) → cross-check with independent data → thesis: what must be true, what would prove it wrong, what to monitor.

scenes.title: Worked example
scenes.vo: Let's work an example, step by step. "Thesis: stablecoin lending on Protocol Z earns about 5% from real borrow demand. Must be true: utilisation 60 to 85%, oracle unchanged, no new risky collateral. Invalidation: utilisation > 95% for 48h, a governance change adding thin collateral, or an incident. Monitor: weekly utilisation, governance feed."
scenes.cap: Let's work an example, step by step. "Thesis: stablecoin lending on Protocol Z earns ~5% from real borrow demand. Must be true: utilisation 60–85%, oracle unchanged, no new risky collateral. Invalidation: utilisation > 95% for 48h, a governance change adding thin collateral, or an incident. Monitor: weekly utilisation, governance feed."

scenes.title: Checklist
items: Evidence from at least two independent sources
